evidence: Modifies RPC help text in src/rpc/net.cpp and bitcoin-cli netinfo logic in src/bitcoin-cli.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a minor integer overflow display bug in `bitcoin-cli -netinfo` and clarifies RPC help documentation. Manual peer counts exceeding 255 wrapped `uint8_t`, causing the column to disappear or show incorrect counts, which is a narrow cosmetic fix alongside an RPC help text clarification.
